title: UHV era (docs/eras/uhv.md, Validator)
note: UHV era per docs/eras/uhv.md ("Validator (-Tier uhv)", "Gate to UEV"), in three substages: uhv (home and Earth orbit), then uhv-mercury (Mercury and its orbit, the swarm) and uhv-proxima (Proxima b and its orbit, the gate), reached by different trips and siblings of each other. Dimension ids come from tables/orbits.json and tables/places.json through the orbit and place tokens (gcyr:mercury is IV's). UV's "nothing UHV" circuit check is dropped: UHV recipes use the mainframe. "Nothing in UHV asks for UEV" is the era rule with the UEV items as a resource.

dimension.note: LuV's list plus the Nether: GTM's nether air collector only runs there, and UHV is the first era that needs its neon (positron cartridge, antihydrogen, the gate's open run), so a recipe valid there needs the nether-trip's key (UHV escalation, 2026-10-28).

synthetic.note: The network's UHV tier (A9): UHV only when every formed tower holds UHV cells, linked by the nuclear clock (tables/wireless_energy.json). wireless:uhv is the gate's "network at UHV".
B7 (uhv/gate.js): the UEV casing's station research (the chart, VA[UV]); stationResearch adds the research_station recipe at load, as in uv.json's research-sgr-a-star.
An EU source into the network at 8,388,608 EU/t (c2), written final: not in power/generators.js's doubling list (uhv-validator.test.mjs checks both).
The seventh station (B1): a package launched to Mercury's orbit (tables/orbits.json `mercury`, the level 7 rocket already flies).
The level 8 rocket (A8, B1): the ICAN motor (GCYR motor tier 6) and the tier 11 BNNT tank; reaches Proxima b and its orbit (the eighth station).

The Nether (a portal from the start; LV's era report already lists its veins as a hand trip): GTM's nether air collector runs there, and the factory's vacuum freezer and distillation tower make its neon (UHV escalation, 2026-10-28).

AE2's matter condenser with a 256k storage component makes a singularity from 256,000 voided items (CondenserOutput.SINGULARITY): a machine mode, not a recipe, so the dump has none (UHV escalation, 2026-10-28).
